calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-11-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change/Gender Identity.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, Proceedings reported by: Miles Lendway, CSR#13684.
Petitioner Jose Carreto Crucillo, aka Jose Carreto, aka Tamara Carreto present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined through Spanish Interpreter Karla Lopez.
Proof of Publication not required.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name to Tamara Miranda.
Decree Changing Name signed in open court.
